vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Magento SessionReaper — PHP Object Injection / Session Fixation
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PHP object injection via crafted session cookie in Magento/Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Exploited in mass campaign targeting merchant checkout flows. CVSS 9.1.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor patches immediately. Block exploitation via WAF rule for crafted session tokens.
vulnerabilities.notes: 250+ stores compromised overnight in March 2026 campaign. Patch: Adobe Commerce 2.4.8-p1 or later.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SQL injection in Ivanti Endpoint Manager allows unauthenticated remote code execution via the core server.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply Ivanti EPM 2022 SU5 or later.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FortiOS SSL VPN allows remote code execution without authentication.
Command injection in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allows unauthenticated RCE.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply hotfixes or upgrade PAN-OS. Enable Threat Prevention Threat ID 95187.
vulnerabilities.notes: CVSS 10.0. Actively exploited by UNC4878 / Volexity-tracked actor.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Authentication bypass via path traversal in Ivanti ICS / IPS allows attacker to access restricted resources.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply patches released January 2024 or later.
